limitations: This correctness fix has a modeled cost, not a claimed speedup.
Model assumes perfect D-cache, no SQ/DMA/interrupt or unrelated bus contention; cold I starts empty once per fixture run.
Replay geometry is an observed edge; real geometry and TA submission are excluded from target timing.
Host TA comparison uses production portable geometry and a documented C SQ-walk adapter, not SH4 FTRV/FSRRA or a recorded game frame.
Loads/stores include stack, literals and helper accesses; architectural bytes and 32-byte line touches are not cache misses or bus transfers.
Distinct line union describes a whole replay batch, never a per-piece working set. Segment touches count repeated lines between geometry edges.
Production code sizes are object sections, not linked-disc sizes. Stack increase is +384-byte parent plus +16-byte flush = +400-byte nested path.
Frame values price only replay for synthetic 500-piece occupancy; the admission 8-byte read and write per piece and actual cache miss timing are additional.
No Flycast run, console run, complete game frame, disc image or room-memory gate was performed in this lane.
